semiconductor_relevance: High — Daxin Materials Corp. specializes in providing customized materials and chemicals specifically designed for semiconductor applications.
summary: Daxin Materials Corporation, founded in 2006, focuses on developing innovative materials and chemicals tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include wet chemicals, functionalized materials, and polymer solutions that enhance semiconductor manufacturing processes.
capabilities: Customized wet chemicals for semiconductor processes

regional_presence.Taiwan: Daxin Materials Corporation is headquartered in Taichung City, Taiwan, and is listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange.
